we have designed an evolvable robot navigation system using FPGA-based hardware and intrinsic evolution, which is capable of evolving the robotic behaviors on a real-world robot platform.

the design of a reconfigurable robotic system capable of evolving its hardware architectures in order to adapt to changes in its dynamic environments.
the design and implementation issues of the evolvable hardware-based robotic systems and the application of the proposed system in the real-world robot navigation.

the development of a hardware-based autonomous robot controller capable of learning and adapting to dynamic changes via artificial evolution, and the results demonstrate that the evolvable robotic controller is capable of achieving adaptive robotic behaviors in real time.
